title: Spells catalog document
description: Shape of presets/<mode>/spells.json. Loaded by presets.loadSpells / getSpell. Storage: catalog document (array rows in one file).

id.description: Spell id referenced by classes.spells, mode auto families, etc. Player auto is mode-gated (not strategy spellPriority). Monsters use kit attacks[], not spell auto ids.

kind.description: Combat kind (docs/09). AI and resolve treat heal/auto specially.

basePower.description: Curve base power (0 for pure autos). Scales strike mean damage.

damageAmplitude.description: Half-width fraction around strike mean (0.2 → min/max = mean×0.8 / mean×1.2). Omitted → 0 (fixed damage at mean). Autos ignore this field.

level.description: Minimum character level required to cast (from spell_ref / Legacy rune:level when matched).

magicLevel.description: Minimum magic skill required to cast (Legacy rune:magicLevel). Runtime checks combatStats.magic (profile magicLevel normalizes to magic).

hitChance.description: Percent; default 100 in combat code if omitted.

requiresAmmo.description: When true, distance auto needs ammo (null ammo = infinite).

ammoPerShot.description: Ammo consumed on successful auto when requiresAmmo.

moveLock.description: Seconds of post-cast moveDelay (0 disables; omit uses Settings default).

cooldowns.description: Buckets: auto | primary | secondary | spell | item → key → duration seconds.

shape.description: Optional AoE / wave shape. Area uses type+code; wave uses type+spread+length. Designer: Select opens shape catalog with matrix preview (kernel/core/lib/shapes.js).

type.description: area = radial matrix by code; wave/beam = directed pattern by spread×length.

code.description: Area effect code (int or legacy name string). Used when type=area.

length.description: Wave/beam length key (int or named custom key).

legacyName.description: Optional legacy display name for ports.

vocations.description: Allowed class vocations for this spell (relation: kind=classes).

source.description: Cast origin. source=rune spells are inventory-linked (runeItemId); mana is typically 0.

rune.description: Legacy/display label for the rune (not used for inventory match).

runeItemId.description: Stackable equipment template id consumed when rune consumption is on (category rune in equipment.json).

field.description: Elemental field kind deployed on the spell footprint (docs/26).

deploysField.description: Alias of field for deploy path (creature kits use the same keys).

destroysField.description: When true, cast clears an active elemental field on the target tile instead of deploying.

statusOnly.description: No meaningful direct damage (use min/max 0). Field deploy / conditions are the effect.

min.description: Fixed damage floor when set (overrides power curve). Field runes use 0.

max.description: Fixed damage ceiling when set (overrides power curve). Field runes use 0.

requiresTarget.description: Whether cast needs a primary target for center/aim.
